query: SELECT id, label FROM profession p WHERE translate(lower(label), 'àâäéèêëïîôöùûüçñ', 'aaaeeeeiioouuucn') LIKE '%' || translate($1, 'àâäéèêëïîôöùûüçñ', 'aaaeeeeiioouuucn') || '%' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM specialty s, medical_act a, unnest(a.motifs) AS m WHERE s.profession_id = p.id AND a.specialty_id = s.id AND translate(lower(m), 'àâäéèêëïîôöùûüçñ', 'aaaeeeeiioouuucn') LIKE '%' || translate($1, 'àâäéèêëïîôöùûüçñ', 'aaaeeeeiioouuucn') || '%') ORDER BY label LIMIT 5
